title: Beatrice Chebet Misses 2026 World XC (Pregnancy)
excerpt: Double Olympic champion Beatrice Chebet missed the 2026 World Cross Country Championships to begin a maternity break. Agnes Ngetich won the women's title.
body:
Beatrice Chebet, the double Olympic champion and two-time defending world cross country champion, did not race the 2026 World Athletics Cross Country Championships in Tallahassee on January 10. She had been named a reserve for Kenya, withdrew, and days later announced she was pregnant and taking a maternity break for the 2026 season.

Without her, the senior women's title went to her compatriot Agnes Ngetich.

For the rest of us, the lesson is simple: seasons rarely go to plan. When illness, injury or life changes your calendar, choose a new target that fits the time you have, rather than trying to squeeze the original plan into fewer weeks.

If your training is interrupted, keep running at a reduced, consistent level instead of stopping completely. A smaller amount of steady training protects the fitness base you will build on when you can train fully again.

Sources: LetsRun.com; Athletics Illustrated
keyTakeaway: When your season changes unexpectedly, reset the goal instead of forcing the original plan.
